provenance.label: HAND-AUTHORED. NOT A RECORDING.
provenance.note: Written by hand from the published KSeF OpenAPI contract. No request was ever sent to api-test.ksef.mf.gov.pl, or to any other host, to produce this file. The field names and types come from the contract; every value is invented.
invented: ksefNumber: the worked example from the ministry's numer-ksef.md, whose CRC-8 and NIP check digit both hold
acquisitionDate: deliberately on the same UTC day (2025-08-26) as the date embedded in that number, which is what the cross-check in ksef-client.ts verifies
invoiceHash: base64 SHA-256 of an ASCII marker string, not of any invoice XML
formCode: the FA(3) triple as the ministry's schema documentation spells it; unverified against a live response
amounts, names, invoiceNumber: invented, and the NIPs are the two that appear in this repo's existing KSeF tests
